title: Multifunctional Flettner rotors: reduced-order models and data (ro-pax Galicia, Portsmouth–Bilbao)
description:
Python reduced-order models and data behind the article Multifunctional Flettner rotors for wind-assisted ship propulsion: a comparative energy assessment of extension, turbine and Savonius-conversion topologies (submitted to Applied Energy).

The models compare a conventional Flettner rotor with multifunctional rotors (a vertical-axis wind turbine that assists their spin or generates electricity, a telescopic extension, or opening into a Savonius turbine) on the ro-pax ferry Galicia on the Portsmouth–Bilbao route, at sea and at berth, with the 2026 timetable and hourly ERA5 winds for 2015–2024. They include a double-multiple streamtube model of the turbine, validated against wind-tunnel and field data, the hourly simulation of optimal and rule-based switching between modes and a Monte Carlo analysis of coefficient uncertainty.

(2018), NACA 0021 section data distributed with Sandia's CACTUS code under the BSD 3-Clause licence, and coastlines from Natural Earth, in the public domain).
